trials.claim: Can add unlimited live streams to each event via YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, or custom RTMP/HLS
trials.claimQuote: Add unlimited live streams to each event. Add YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, or your custom RTMP/HLS
trials.reasoning: The reviews mention multiple or multi-track live streams, but none say streams are unlimited or that YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch, or custom RTMP/HLS can be added.

exhibits.quote: BeHuman.Online is a powerful platform for running virtual and hybrid events, offering a robust suite of features like customizable branding, multi-track live streams, exhibitor booths, and interactive lounges for networking.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms the platform offers multi-track live streams as part of its event features.

exhibits.quote: The platform provides a seamless user experience with advanced features like multiple live streams 🎥, interactive lounges 🤝, and customizable exhibitor pages 🎭.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms buyers experienced multiple live streams working on the platform.

trials.claim: Platform is a virtual conference / expo / coaching / meet-up platform that engages attendees
trials.claimQuote: Virtual conference / expo / coaching / meet-up platform that engages attendees
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes the platform for professional events and coaching groups with high engagement, and a buyer confirms hosting a medical conference where attendees were thoroughly impressed.

exhibits.quote: I do not want to force my webinar guests to sign up for a third-party platform just to attend my webinar.
exhibits.argument: Forcing guests to create a third-party account contradicts the claim of an engaging attendee experience.

exhibits.quote: I will be requesting a refund after writing this review.
exhibits.argument: Requesting a refund undermines the claim that the platform engages attendees.

exhibits.quote: Professional events, associations, coaching groups, foster a friendly and collaborative environment. High engagement, at low cost.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes its product for professional events and coaching groups with high engagement.

exhibits.quote: We hosted a medical conference on BeHuman.Online - the attendees were thoroughly impressed with the experience, and most importantly, the client loved it.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms hosting a conference on the platform with impressed attendees.

trials.claim: Includes easy AWS integration to add video calls between attendees
trials.claimQuote: Easy integration with AWS to add video calls between attendees
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly says the AWS integration is easy and worked well, and another confirms cost-effective AWS integration; the vague warnings do not directly contradict that.

exhibits.quote: Also, there's the whole AWS consideration. I suggest reading up on that aspect of the platform.
exhibits.argument: Warning buyers to research the AWS aspect undermines the claim that AWS integration is easy.

exhibits.quote: There is a bit of a learning curve, but there are tutorials that help.
exhibits.argument: Admitting a learning curve undermines the claim that AWS integration is easy.

exhibits.quote: So I love this platform - mostly. The integration with AWS is easy and worked pretty well.
exhibits.argument: Buyer directly confirms the AWS integration is easy and works.

exhibits.quote: With its flexibility, cost-effective AWS integration, and standout customer service, BeHuman.Online is definitely worth checking out for anyone looking to elevate their virtual event experience
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the platform has AWS integration that is cost-effective.

trials.claim: Can generate access codes to delegate access or import to ticketing service for distribution
trials.claimQuote: Generate access codes - delegate access or import to ticketing service for distribution
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit says ticketing could be more straightforward, which does not show whether access codes can be generated, delegated, or imported to a ticketing service.

exhibits.quote: Ticketing - ticketing for events could be more straightforward, although we have external solutions.
exhibits.argument: Saying ticketing could be more straightforward undermines the claim about easy ticketing distribution.
